description: This file contains implementation of utility functions for RFC management, including system command execution, RFC parameter reading via rbus or other methods, waiting for RFC processing completion, and parsing DCM settings from configuration files.

methods.name: std::string getSyseventValue(const std::string & key)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a system event identified by the key by executing a shell command.

methods.name: void waitForRfcCompletion()
methods.description: Waits until the RFC blob processing is completed or times out after multiple retries, checking system events and the existence of a specific file.

methods.name: int read_RFCProperty(const char * type,const char * key,char * out_value,int datasize)
methods.description: Reads an RFC parameter value through rbus if supported, otherwise uses legacy method, and outputs the value into provided buffer.

methods.name: int executeCommandAndGetOutput(SYSCMD eSysCmd,const char * pArgs,std::string & result)
methods.description: Executes specified system commands and captures their output into a string.

methods.name: bool CheckSpecialCharacters(const std::string & str)
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: bool StringCaseCompare(const std::string & str1,const std::string & str2)
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: void RemoveSubstring(std::string & str,const std::string & toRemove)
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a specified substring from a string.

methods.name: std::string getCronFromDCMSettings()
methods.description: Reads DCM scheduling cron expression from configuration files, with fallback and logging.

ctags.name: executeCommandAndGetOutput
ctags.pattern: /^int executeCommandAndGetOutput(SYSCMD eSysCmd,  const char *pArgs, std::string& result) $/

ctags.name: read_RFCProperty
ctags.pattern: /^int read_RFCProperty(const char* type, const char* key, char *out_value, int datasize)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * type,const char * key,char * out_value,int datasize)
